# Configuration reference (kongtrol.yaml)

Version 1.6 · 2026-11-19

Every key of `~/.kongtrol/kongtrol.yaml`, read from the schema (`internal/config/schema.go`). Defaults are the ones the code applies. Guide with examples: [CONFIGURATION.md](CONFIGURATION.md) · full example: [configs/example.yaml](../configs/example.yaml) · Español: [CONFIG.md](CONFIG.md).

## `vpns`

Your VPN profiles, one per name (`vpns.office`, `vpns.home`, …). At least one.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vpns.<name>.type` | string | — | **Required.** VPN type (adapter). Values: `forticlient`, `openvpn`, `protonvpn`, `nordvpn`, `surfshark`, `ciscoanyconnect`, `wireguard`, `globalprotect`, `tailscale`, `cloudflarewarp`. |
| `vpns.<name>.version` | string | — | Client version, informational only. |
| `vpns.<name>.host` | string | — | VPN server or gateway (corporate clients). |
| `vpns.<name>.port` | int | — | Server port. |
| `vpns.<name>.tunnel_name` | string | — | Name of the connection saved in the client (e.g. FortiClient). |
| `vpns.<name>.allow_insecure_cert` | bool | — | FortiClient only: accept certificate warnings while automating the app. Keep it `false` (MITM risk). |
| `vpns.<name>.config` | string | — | Path to the `.ovpn` (openvpn) or `.conf` (wireguard) file. |
| `vpns.<name>.server` | string | — | Exact server (protonvpn, nordvpn). |
| `vpns.<name>.protocol` | string | — | Provider protocol: `wireguard` or `openvpn` (protonvpn). |
| `vpns.<name>.binary_path` | string | — | Path to the VPN client program when it isn't detected. |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.method` | string | — | **Required.** How it authenticates: `certificate`, `credentials` or `certificate+credentials`. For protonvpn, nordvpn and surfshark it is `credentials` when left out. |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.cert` | string | — | Path to the client certificate. |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.key` | string | — | Path to the private key. |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.username` | string | — | Plain-text username (low sensitivity). |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.username_keychain` | string | — | Keychain entry name that holds the username. |
| `vpns.<name>.auth.password_keychain` | string | — | Keychain entry name that holds the password. |
| `vpns.<name>.priority` | int | — | Tie-break between overlapping policies: policies of a profile with a higher number are evaluated first (domains and apps: the first match wins; IPs: the most specific range always wins and priority only breaks ties between ranges of the same size). When unset, the policy's position counts (earlier first). It never connects or switches profiles. |
| `vpns.<name>.kill_switch` | bool | — | Turns the kill switch on or off for this profile only (when missing, `security.kill_switch.enabled` applies). |
| `vpns.<name>.failover` | list of string | — | Backup profiles, in order, that Kongtrol may connect if this one drops and cannot reconnect. When unset, it never connects another profile: it notifies you and keeps retrying this one. Each must exist, cannot be this same profile and cannot form a loop. |
| `vpns.<name>.auto_connect` | bool | — | Providers with an official app: try to connect on its own (official CLI or automation) before asking you to connect in the app. When missing: `true`. |
| `vpns.<name>.country` | string | — | Server country (code or name), for providers that can select one. |
| `vpns.<name>.city` | string | — | Server city, for providers that can select one. |
| `vpns.<name>.group` | string | — | nordvpn only: server group (`P2P`, `Dedicated IP`, `Double VPN`, `Onion Over VPN`). |
| `vpns.<name>.interface` | string | — | Tunnel interface name patterns (comma-separated globs); replaces the provider's. |
| `vpns.<name>.wait_timeout` | string | — | How long `up` waits for you to connect in the app (Go duration; 5m when missing, minimum 10s). |
| `vpns.<name>.app_path` | string | — | Where to launch the provider's app from. |

## `groups`

Profile groups connected or disconnected together with `--group <name>`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `groups.<name>.profiles` | list of string | — | **Required.** Profiles in the group (names from `vpns`). |

## `policies`

Rules that decide which VPN each destination uses, in order.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policies[].name` | string | — | **Required.** Rule name. |
| `policies[].match.ip_ranges` | list of string | — | IP ranges in CIDR notation. |
| `policies[].match.domains` | list of string | — | Domains or globs (`*.example.com`). |
| `policies[].match.apps` | list of string | — | Executables or globs (experimental). |
| `policies[].via` | string | — | **Required.** VPN profile the traffic goes through. |
| `policies[].on_tunnel_down` | string | — | What happens to this traffic while its tunnel is off: `allow` (default: normal internet plus a notice), `block` (it doesn't leave) or `connect` (Kongtrol connects the tunnel). |

## `security`

Protections: kill switch, DNS guard, checks and audit log.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `security.kill_switch.enabled` | bool | — | Blocks a protected tunnel's destinations if it drops without you turning it off. |
| `security.kill_switch.mode` | string | `strict` | Compatibility: `loose` means `allow_lan: true`. Values: `strict`, `loose`. |
| `security.kill_switch.allow_lan` | bool | — | Keeps the local network (printers, NAS, router) reachable while a full tunnel is down; DNS lookups may then leave through your network's DNS. When `false`, a drop also cuts the local network until the VPN returns. |
| `security.dns_guard.enabled` | bool | — | Forces the VPN's DNS while tunnels are connected (prevents DNS leaks). |
| `security.dns_guard.fallback_dns` | string | — | Fallback DNS when the VPN pushes none. |
| `security.integrity_check.enabled` | bool | — | Periodically checks that every tunnel is still healthy. |
| `security.integrity_check.interval` | string | `120s` | How often (Go duration). |
| `security.integrity_check.expected_ips` | map of string to string | — | Expected public IP per profile (`profile: ip`), to detect leaks. |
| `security.leak_detection.enabled` | bool | — | Legacy block: `true` counts as opting in to the public IP lookup. |
| `security.public_ip_check.enabled` | bool | — | Opt-in lookup of your public IP at an external service (that service sees your IP). Off when missing. |
| `security.public_ip_check.endpoints` | list of string | — | `https://` URLs tried in order; empty = the default one. |
| `security.audit_log.path` | string | — | Audit log file. |
| `security.audit_log.max_size_mb` | int | `100` | Largest size of one file (MB); past it the same day continues in audit-YYYY-MM-DD.1.log, .2… (default 100). |
| `security.audit_log.retention_days` | int | `30` | Days kept, today included (1 to 365; unset or 0 = 30). Older days are deleted at start, when a file fills up and every midnight. |
| `security.audit_log.max_total_mb` | int | `500` | Largest space of all files together (MB, 1 to 10240; unset or 0 = 500, never less than one file). Past it the oldest are deleted first. |
| `security.audit_log.sign` | bool | — | Signs every entry with HMAC-SHA256 (detects tampering). |

## `monitor`

Monitoring, dashboard, scheduler and alerts.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `monitor.enabled` | bool | — | Turns monitoring on. |
| `monitor.dashboard.port` | int | `9741` | Dashboard local port (`kongtrol config dashboard set-port` changes it on this computer only). |
| `monitor.dashboard.bind` | string | `127.0.0.1` | Address the dashboard listens on. |
| `monitor.health_check.interval` | string | `30s` | How often each tunnel is checked (Go duration). |
| `monitor.health_check.timeout` | string | `10s` | Maximum time per check. |
| `monitor.history.path` | string | — | File holding per-profile stability history. |
| `monitor.history.flush_interval` | string | `30s` | How often the history is saved. |
| `monitor.scheduler.enabled` | bool | — | Connects profiles on a schedule. |
| `monitor.scheduler.interval` | string | `1m` | How often schedules are evaluated. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].name` | string | — | Schedule rule name. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].profiles` | list of string | — | Profiles that must be connected in that window. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].weekdays` | list of string | — | Days (`mon` … `sun`), optional. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].start` | string | — | Start time `HH:MM` (24h), optional. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].end` | string | — | End time `HH:MM` (24h), optional. |
| `monitor.scheduler.rules[].enabled` | bool | — | `false` pauses the rule without deleting it (default on). Rule, interval and on/off changes apply without a restart. |
| `monitor.split_dns.enabled` | bool | — | Resolves each domain with its tunnel's DNS (split DNS). |
| `monitor.split_dns.interval` | string | `60s` | How often split DNS is refreshed. |
| `monitor.alerts.on_vpn_drop.actions` | list of string | — | Actions when a VPN drops: `notify`, `log`, `kill_switch`. |
| `monitor.alerts.on_leak_detected.actions` | list of string | — | Actions when a leak is detected: `notify`, `log`, `kill_switch`. |
| `monitor.alerts.on_high_latency_ms` | int | — | Alert when latency exceeds these milliseconds. |
| `monitor.alerts.on_reconnect_attempts` | int | — | Alert after this many reconnect attempts. |
| `monitor.recent_connections.enabled` | bool | — | Recent destinations list (`kongtrol traffic recent`): memory only, never on disk or off this computer; 500 destinations, each forgotten 1 h after last seen. On by default (Windows and Linux); `false` turns it off and erases it. |

## `updates`

New version notice (optional).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `updates.check_enabled` | bool | — | Tells you when a new version exists: asks api.github.com at most once a day (only your IP and `kongtrol/<version>` are sent). Never downloads or installs. Off when missing. |

`~/` paths expand to your home folder and `${VAR}` to environment variables. Passwords never go here: they live in the OS keychain.
